title: Contextual exemplar‑blend sampler for production calibration packs
creator: Evan Clarke
description:
Goal: define and implement a per-domain calibration dataset curation method that combines contextual importance sampling with exemplar blending and lightweight synthetic augmentation to produce compact (~1-5k examples/domain) calibration packs for FP8/INT8 quantization validation. The sampler should preserve production prompt distribution characteristics (length, token distribution, prompt-template families), prioritize high‑impact traffic slices, and ensure coverage of long‑tail intents without biasing common cases.

Why: existing reservoir and stratified samplers either underrepresent rare intents or produce large packs that are expensive to run during automated regression checks. This work aims to produce smaller, higher‑signal packs that correlate better with observed production accuracy regressions after quantization changes.

Scope: design sampling algorithm, build prototype data pipeline to generate packs for 6 internal domains (chat, search, summarization, code-gen, customer-support, forms), add metrics and dashboards for pack quality, run calibration experiments (FP8, INT8) with runtime-1.20 kernels, and validate correlation with A/B prompt holdouts from live traffic.

Non‑goals: full per-tenant personalization (we will begin with domain-level packs), end-to-end model repo changes, and production rollout of automated pack refresh (this will be follow-up).
acceptance_criteria: Sampler design doc approved by PM and Research: includes formalized importance weighting, exemplar blend rules, and augmentation heuristics
Prototype pipeline can generate a per-domain pack (1k-5k prompts) for each of the 6 domains and store outputs in calibration storage
Calibration pack quality metrics computed: within-pack diversity, length distribution match to production, head/tail coverage score
Quantization validation runs (FP8 and INT8) executed on runtime-1.20 for the generated packs with automated reporting of delta metrics versus full production holdout (accuracy PPL/relevance metrics)
Observed correlation >= 0.75 between pack validation regressions and production holdout regressions for at least 4 of 6 domains
Pipeline includes provenance metadata (source window, anonymized tenant tags, sampling parameters) for auditability
tasks: Write design doc: importance weighting formula, exemplar selection, blending heuristics, augmentation rules
Implement sampler microservice (Python) with input adapters for replay logs and embedding clustering
Add sampling telemetry hooks: why each example was selected, sampling score, exemplar ancestry
Create generation job to emit 6 domain packs and upload to calibration-bucket
Run FP8/INT8 calibration experiments and produce regression report
Integrate basic dashboard tiles in Console (pack stats, correlation heatmap)
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: synthetic augmentation could introduce artifacts that don't appear in production — Mitigation: keep augmentation conservative and label augmented examples in provenance
Risk: overfitting to historical replay data — Mitigation: include recent live holdout and apply temporal decay to importance weights
Risk: packs may not generalize across customers — Mitigation: validate correlation on per-tenant samples and flag domains with low correlation for follow‑up
metrics: Head/tail coverage score (percent of intents covered above frequency threshold)
Correlation coefficient between pack regression and production holdout regression
False-positive rate of pack-flagged regressions vs production
